group.passage: Imagine being unable to wash your clothes or hair because you can’t afford laundry detergent or shampoo. Imagine sharing a toothbrush with other family members or staying away from your friends because of not having soap or period products. This is the reality for an estimated 2.3 billion people in the world. The high cost of living combined with limited financial resources leaves many individuals and families struggling to afford basic hygiene products. However, most of us are unaware hygiene poverty exists and do not understand the devastating impact it can have on people’s physical and mental well-being. One of the immediate consequences of hygiene poverty is the adverse impact on personal hygiene and health. When individuals cannot afford items like sanitary products, they are forced to resort to unsanitary alternatives or reuse items, which can lead to infections and health issues. Moreover, the lack of access to hygiene essentials contributes to low self-esteem and a sense of shame, causing psychological distress and obstructing social interactions. ■❶ Children are particularly vulnerable to the effects of hygiene poverty. Without access to clean diapers, soap, and adequate sanitary facilities, their health and well-being are compromised. ■❷ Additionally, the absence of proper hygiene practices can hinder their educational opportunities, as they may miss school due to embarrassment or health-related issues. This perpetuates a cycle of poverty and limited prospects for a better future. To combat hygiene poverty, collective action is essential. Charitable organizations and non-government organizations play a crucial role in providing hygiene kits and support to those in need. By partnering with local communities, they can distribute essential hygiene products, raise awareness, and offer educational programs on hygiene practices. ■❸ Individuals can contribute to tackling hygiene poverty by supporting local initiatives, donating hygiene products, or volunteering their time and skills. ■❹ Advocacy is also crucial to creating a general understanding of the issue so that hygiene poverty is recognized and actively combated. Hygiene poverty is a serious problem that has a significant impact on the lives of billions of people. The consequences of hygiene poverty can be far-reaching, impacting both physical and mental health. It is only through collective efforts that we can ensure everyone has access to the basic hygiene products they need to stay healthy and well.
